findings.message: INI directive 'mbstring.func_overload' is deprecated since PHP 7.2 and removed since PHP 8.0 (ini_get()/ini_set() of a directive that no longer exists returns false without an error, and this directive was already gone before PHP 8.3, so the upgrade changes nothing)

Since PHP 7.0, functions inspecting arguments, like func_get_arg(), no longer report the original value as passed to a parameter, but will instead provide the current value. The parameter "$env" was used, and possibly changed (by reference), on line 46. (PHP 7.0 behaviour: code that runs on PHP 7 or 8 today already gets this behaviour, so the upgrade changes nothing)
